linkedIn.headline: Sr. Manager, Sales Engineering at Splunk
linkedIn.about:
Experienced technical sales engineer successful in closing large deals with Fortune-500 companies.  Proficient in presenting to CxO level management, as well as technical overviews and demonstrations, writing proposals and RFIs, and training or consulting with customers and partners. Accomplished in team management, systems & database administration, and programming. Product and industry knowledge and experience spans areas including Systems and Database Management and Administration, Application Integration, Web Services, Customer Support and CRM.

Specialties: Technical Sales Engineer: Enterprise Management / Internet Infrastructure / Security / Sales / Team Management / Consultant / CRM / Technical Writing
